title: Font: stb_truetype initialization (Nerd Font TTF loading)
acceptance_criteria: Nerd Font TTF file loaded from disk or embedded as binary data
stbtt_InitFont() parses font header and builds lookup tables
Font scale computed for target pixel height (e.g., 16px)
Glyph metrics (advance, bearing, dimensions) retrievable by codepoint
Font supports Nerd Font icon codepoints (U+E000-U+U+26FF range)
Fallback to default glyph for missing codepoints
Font loading error handled gracefully (missing file, corrupt data)
Unit test verifies font loads and returns valid metrics for test codepoint
